title: Feed calculated rows directly into an observed hosted terminal Partition
question: Can hosted Run remove an augmented Dataset pass while retaining calculation observations and exact staged error order?
summary: The 650,003-row job saves 1.322–1.502 seconds and removes 243.6 MB from each direction of tracked temporary traffic. The small ineligible control keeps its data movement.

workloads: A 650,003-row, eight-key calculated Partition over the 128 MiB guard and a 90,003-row control below it.

validation.summary: Exact CSV bytes, keys, order, lineage, caps and markers. Source edges, calculated error precedence, partition-only denial, and cancellation cleanup were verified.

limitations: One bundled Chromium host and two fixture sizes. No device I/O or RSS inference.
exclusions: Compressed output, composed pipelines, explicit preparation, observed native fusion and experimental constant Partition.
